configuration.E1: frozen pre-Task5 module, all published defaults
configuration.linewidth: manifest rendered linewidth, else intrinsic; estimation only if both absent
configuration.latency: solver + decode samples; initialization and Python bookkeeping charged to first frame; one warmup sequence per estimator/cohort excluded
configuration.classification: Nonexclusive indicators on lost sequences; residual threshold is cohort/estimator median x3, not proof of a local minimum. Width changes test sensitivity, not causation.
configuration.line_depths: None for both E1 and E2; source depths predate augmentation and are not permitted calibration

historical_fieldcone_120_legacy_truth_in.initialization: true frame0 centers; historical diagnostic only, ineligible comparison

dev_clean_cold_acquisition.initialization: shared observed frame0 detector plus fixed bias; no truth
